project.title: Barefoot sole with parametric mechanics and organic sidewall skin

coordinate_frame.origin: heel center on the ground datum
coordinate_frame.x_axis: +X toward lateral side for the right shoe

requirements.statement: The parametric sole shall preserve the measured foot outline, toe splay, zero-drop policy, thickness zones, and upper attachment interface.
requirements.verification: dimension report, foot/last overlay, and physical fitting prototype

requirements.statement: Organic sidewall decoration shall not bridge or stiffen protected flex grooves beyond the accepted bending target.
requirements.verification: keep-out collision, section checks, and bend/torsion coupons

requirements.statement: The sidewall shall carry a continuous flowing honeycomb-to-vine motif while the tread and attachment lip remain parametrically controlled.
requirements.verification: matched wrap renders and slicer detail review

global_style.summary: low, fast, flowing barefoot silhouette with medium-scale hexagonal/vine texture wrapping the sidewall
motifs: flow lines from heel to toe
global_style.detail_hierarchy: sole outline and lip first, flowing bands second, sparse cells third

assembly_sequence: Approve the measured sole core and protected foot/flex volumes.
Generate the sidewall skin only inside the exported occupancy envelope.
Register and trim the skin to the parametric curved rim/backer.
Fuse as one TPU body or validate a multi-material TPU union in the target slicer.
Print bending, tear, and upper-attachment coupons before a full shoe.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the intended foot last and size range.
decision_log.current_basis: Example last and envelope are illustrative.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Measured last or scan, target size range, and wearer fit trial.

decision_log.topic: Qualify TPU grade, print profile, and skin-to-sole joining route.
decision_log.current_basis: TPU 95A profile is a starting point, not a durability claim.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Material coupons, bond or mechanical-retention trials, flex and wear testing.

components.name: Parametric barefoot sole core
components.role: measured outline, thickness, tread mechanics, flex zones, and foot/upper interface

manufacturing.orientation: outsole on bed unless coupon evidence supports another route

components.name: Parametric curved sidewall rim and skin backer
components.role: upper attachment lip, controlled curvature, trim body, and structural transition

components.name: Organic sidewall motif skin
components.role: appearance-dominant curved sidewall surface outside functional zones

manufacturing.method: fused mesh body or verified multi-material body
manufacturing.orientation: inherit sole after union; validate toolpaths around relief

image_to_3d.positive_prompt: A continuous shallow sculptural sidewall skin for a barefoot shoe, elongated honeycomb cells flowing into vine-like bands from heel to toe, low aerodynamic relief, thick sacrificial inner skirt, quiet top and bottom seam bands, matte neutral clay.
negative_spaces: cell openings remain above the process-tested minimum and do not cross seam bands

nominal_geometry.type: perimeter loft and continuous overlap band

requirements.load_or_flow: foot support and upper attachment load

nominal_geometry.type: curved wrap substrate plus clipped relief occupancy

joining.method: registered mesh trimmed to backer then unioned

requirements.load_or_flow: appearance skin; shall not become the sole flexure authority

keepouts.purpose: coarse foot/upper occupancy proxy; exact last/foot surface lives in CAD
coarse union of protected flex-groove volumes; exact swept regions live in CAD

validation.acceptance: sole/rim own function and organic skin owns appearance only

validation.method: assemble last, sole, rim, flex keep-outs, and skin envelope
mesh intake, wrap views, landmarks, and feature budget
validation.acceptance: continuous skin, correct envelope, and quiet seam bands

validation.method: curved registration, overlap, distortion, and wall checks
validation.acceptance: all interface requirements pass without flex-zone bridging

validation.method: TPU slicer review and multi-material boundary test if selected
validation.acceptance: continuous walls, retained cells, and no trapped support

validation.method: relief strip, bend/torsion, upper attachment, then wearable prototype
validation.acceptance: project-specific flexibility, tear resistance, fit, and comfort targets pass
